chapter: Caravan, Perdido and the first tunes
title: Bakiff and its name
summary: Bakiff is published by Tempo and was named by Duke; Tizol does not know what the word means.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: How about some of the other ones? How about Bakkeef?
Oh, Bakkeef, that's on Temple. Duke named that tune, called Bakriff, which I don't know what it means -- something about Mecca, I don't know.
When they bow and so forth like that, they call 'bakiff' -- I don't know, Duke called it that name; but I don't know what he meant by it. I didn't care, anyhow.
